# Crossle

> Crossle is a competitive online multiplayer word game for iOS and Android. Players compete in real-time crossword-style PvP duels, using strategy and vocabulary to outsmart opponents and climb global leaderboards.

Developed by DCX Studios. Free to download and play.

## Pages

- [Home](https://crossle.app/): Main landing page with game overview, download links for App Store and Google Play, gameplay trailer, interactive letter-connecting demo, and feature highlights.
- [Support](https://crossle.app/support): Help center with FAQ (bug reporting, progress recovery, how to play) and direct contact email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://crossle.app/privacy-policy): Data collection and usage policy for the Crossle app.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://crossle.app/terms): Terms of service for using the Crossle app.

## Download

- App Store (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/crossle-online-word-duel/id6751605835
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dcxstudios.dcm
